interpret_span_value: create a FixedValue object from a number span using interpret_span_value with an interpreter and speaker
interpret_linear_extent: build a LinearExtentAttribute or LinearExtentValue from logical form data using interpret_linear_extent with frame and direction
interpret_task_info: create an AttributeSequence from task info by extracting reference object attributes using interpret_task_info
AttributeInterpreter_call: interpret an attribute logical form into a TableColumn, BBoxSize, or ListAttribute using the AttributeInterpreter callable
maybe_specific_mem: check if a reference object logical form corresponds to an existing ReferenceObject in memory using maybe_specific_mem
